outputs.explanation: Panel A is a 3D rendering of a tomographic reconstruction showing structural features (preconoidal rings, actin filament), not a quantitative plot with statistical comparison.
Panel B is a 3D rendering of cellular structures from tomography, not a statistical plot.
Panel C is a slice through a cryo-EM tomogram image showing filaments, not a quantitative plot requiring statistical testing.
Panel D is a schematic/illustration of a lateral section of the cell, not a data plot.
Panel E is a slice through an averaged tomographic volume, a structural image, not a statistical plot.
Panel F is a tomogram slice image with an observation count (N=2), not a quantitative plot requiring a statistical test.
